strings.name: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus
strings.summary: Born in Asmara when it was part of Ethiopia, Tedros trained in biology, infectious-disease immunology and community health. He served as Ethiopia’s health and foreign minister before becoming WHO Director-General in 2017 and winning reelection in 2022. He promotes universal health coverage and led the organisation’s COVID-19 response, while its judgments, coordination and member-state cooperation faced scrutiny.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Serves as WHO Director-General and participates in global epidemic responses, advancing universal health coverage and cooperation on health systems.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Asmara, then Ethiopia, now Eritrea’s capital.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Biology, Asmara; MSc, University of London (1992); community-health PhD, Nottingham (2000).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Universal health coverage
strings.highlights.h1.text: Promotes primary care and access through national and international roles.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global epidemic coordination
strings.highlights.h2.text: Leads WHO risk assessment, technical guidance and international cooperation.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reelected Director-General
strings.timeline.t1.text: The World Health Assembly elected him for a second five-year term.
strings.timeline.t2.title: COVID-19 described as pandemic
strings.timeline.t2.text: Explained WHO’s assessment that COVID-19 could be characterised as a pandemic.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Took office at WHO
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became the first WHO Director-General from Africa.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Foreign minister
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from health to Ethiopia’s foreign ministry.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Health minister
strings.timeline.t5.text: Led Ethiopian health-system reform and expansion of primary services.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Completed doctorate
strings.timeline.t6.text: Studied dams and malaria transmission at Nottingham.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earned master’s degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed infectious-disease immunology studies at the University of London.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Asmara
strings.timeline.t8.text: Later studied biology at the University of Asmara.
